title: Define the Product Concept
not_for: A build-ready technical specification or a feature backlog.
input_gate: A concept can be provisional, but define the customer outcome, storyboard, non-goals, and an unled comprehension test.

storyboard.user_action: Review imported hours before approving an invoice

concept_test.prompt: Explain what you think happens after approval.
concept_test.observed_understanding: Participant expected a draft, not an automatically sent invoice

example_note: A text storyboard is acceptable before mockups exist. Record the user's explanation rather than the presenter's explanation.
failure_case: Missing visible outputs or unsourced claims that users understood the concept should remain a research plan.
